artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive integer $n$ and integers $b,c$, let $T_n(b,c)$ denote the generalized central trinomial coefficient defined as the coefficient of $x^n$ in $(x^2+bx+c)^n$, equivalently
$$T_n(b,c)=\sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}\binom{n}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}b^{n-2k}c^k.$$
For an odd prime $p$ and integer $a$ with $\gcd(a,p)=1$, let $\left(\tfrac{a}{p}\right)$ denote the Legendre symbol. Prove or disprove the following four statements.

(i) For every prime $p>3$,
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{4k}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}T_k(2702,1)}{384^{2k}}\equiv\begin{cases}4x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{11}\right)=1,\ p=x^2+33y^2,\\ 2p-2x^2\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{11}\right)=-1,\ 2p=x^2+33y^2,\\ 12x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{11}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=-1,\ p=3x^2+11y^2,\\ 2p-6x^2\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{11}\right)=-1,\ 2p=3x^2+11y^2,\\ 0\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-33}{p}\right)=-1,\end{cases}$$
and
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{220k+119}{384^{2k}}\binom{4k}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}T_k(2702,1)\equiv p\!\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)\!\left(55+183\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)\right)\pmod{p^2}.$$

(ii) For every prime $p>3$ with $p\neq 7$,
$$\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{4k}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}T_k(115598,1)}{2688^{2k}}\equiv\begin{cases}4x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{19}\right)=1,\ p=x^2+57y^2,\\ 2p-2x^2\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{19}\right)=-1,\ 2p=x^2+57y^2,\\ 12x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{p}{19}\right)=-1,\ p=3x^2+19y^2,\\ 2p-6x^2\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{19}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=-1,\ 2p=3x^2+19y^2,\\ 0\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-57}{p}\right)=-1,\end{cases}$$
and
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{260k+513}{2688^{2k}}\binom{4k}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}T_k(115598,1)\equiv p\!\left(\tfrac{21}{p}\right)\!\left(961+65\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)\right)\pmod{p^2}.$$

(iii) For every prime $p>3$,
$$\sum_{n=0}^{p-1}\binom{2n}{n}\sum_{k=0}^{n}\binom{n}{k}\binom{n+2k}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}\frac{1}{64^k}\equiv\begin{cases}x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{17}\right)=1,\ 4p=x^2+51y^2,\\ 3x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{17}\right)=-1,\ 4p=3x^2+17y^2,\\ 0\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{51}\right)=-1,\end{cases}$$
and
$$\sum_{n=0}^{p-1}(17n+9)\binom{2n}{n}\sum_{k=0}^{n}\binom{n}{k}\binom{n+2k}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}\frac{1}{64^k}\equiv p\!\left(\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)-7\right)\pmod{p^2}.$$

(iv) For every prime $p>5$,
$$\sum_{n=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2n}{n}}{400^n}\sum_{k=0}^{n}\binom{n}{k}\binom{n+2k}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}196^{n-k}\equiv\begin{cases}x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{2}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{11}\right)=1,\ p=x^2+22y^2,\\ 8x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{2}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{11}\right)=-1,\ p=2x^2+11y^2,\\ 0\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-22}{p}\right)=-1,\end{cases}$$
and
$$\sum_{n=0}^{p-1}\frac{33n+19}{400^n}\binom{2n}{n}\sum_{k=0}^{n}\binom{n}{k}\binom{n+2k}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}196^{n-k}\equiv 19p\pmod{p^2}.$$
